audit_notes: The gold driver sources cited are from a 2025 annual report, which post-dates the April 2024 as-of-date of the candidate content. The candidate drivers are assessed based on available content as of 2024-04-10. All candidate quotes are verbatim.
cause_evidence: The candidate memo relies on specific internal growth targets (15% per-share return) and management-defined earnings (DE) to justify a re-rating, whereas the gold drivers reflect a later, retrospective narrative from a 2025 report.

drivers.candidate_quote: the market has mispriced the business due to structural complexity
drivers.gold_driver: Holding-company complexity created a discount to underlying economic value.
drivers.reason: The candidate asserts structural complexity leads to mispricing, but the cited documents (D04, D05) do not provide evidence that this complexity creates a discount to underlying economic value; they merely acknowledge the complexity as a source of market skepticism.

drivers.candidate_quote: a clear earnings growth algorithm supported by growing fee-bearing capital
drivers.document_quote: Asset management earns recurring fees on third-party capital and performance-related carried interest. Fee-bearing capital was $457 billion at December 2023, up 9%.
drivers.gold_driver: BAM supplies capital-light recurring fee earnings and growth.
drivers.reason: D01 confirms the recurring nature of fee earnings and the growth in fee-bearing capital.

drivers.candidate_quote: supporting a management team with a stellar track record
drivers.document_quote: Management's credibility rests on a long operating and capital-allocation record
drivers.gold_driver: Bruce Flatt and his team are strong long-term capital allocators.
drivers.reason: D01 explicitly supports management's strong track record in operating and capital allocation.

drivers.candidate_quote: a valuation that does not fully reflect the firm’s 15% long-term per-share return target
drivers.document_quote: Management put year-end annualized earnings at $940 million and expected more than $100 billion of assets and $1.3 billion annualized earnings following AEL.
drivers.gold_driver: Insurance growth and future carried interest add value not captured by simple current multiples.
drivers.reason: The documents support that insurance growth (D03) and carried interest/valuation nuances (D05) contribute to the firm's value beyond trailing metrics.

key_problem: The gold drivers are based on a 2025 retrospective document not available at the as-of-date, and the candidate memo is a speculative investment thesis based on 2024 results.

audit_validation.policy: Exact quote failure receives zero for that endpoint; raw judge judgment retained above.
